items.en: Course materials from Canvas now arrive in the same folders as on Canvas; use Organize to move materials synced earlier to match.
items.zh: Canvas 上的课程资料按原目录同步到课程文件中，之前同步的资料可以用「整理」移到对应位置。

items.en: Course materials now offer one simple choice: read them from Canvas, or save them in Semestra so they still open after they are deleted on Canvas.
items.zh: 课程资料的保存方式更简单：从 Canvas 读取，或保存在 Semestra，在 Canvas 上删除后仍能打开。

items.en: File processing now shows as one sidebar line, listing each file with the option to stop it.
items.zh: 文件处理在侧边栏合为一行，可以查看每个文件并停止处理。

items.en: Organize puts loose files into your existing folders and moves materials that changed folders on Canvas.
items.zh: 「整理」会把散落的文件放进已有文件夹，并移动在 Canvas 上换了位置的资料。

items.en: Canvas sync settings are now in one place, and each course can adjust its own course materials.
items.zh: Canvas 同步设置集中到一处，每门课程可以单独调整课程资料。

items.en: A clearer sync status, with progress when you sync now.
items.zh: 同步状态更清晰，立即同步时显示进度。

items.en: Uploading a file the course already has now asks first, including Canvas materials read online and files still uploading.
items.zh: 上传课程中已有的文件时会先询问，包括在线读取的 Canvas 资料和正在上传的文件。

items.en: Creating or renaming a folder to a name already used there shows a clear error on the name.
items.zh: 新建或重命名文件夹时如与已有文件夹重名，会在名称处直接提示。

items.en: Importing a syllabus again no longer saves a second copy to the course files.
items.zh: 再次导入同一份大纲时，不会在课程文件中重复保存。

items.en: The announcements list and the open announcement now scroll separately, and the simplified view uses the full width of the page.
items.zh: 公告列表与正文改为各自独立滚动，简洁样式下正文占满整个宽度。

items.en: Sync status marks new course materials that match a file you uploaded yourself.
items.zh: 同步状态会标出与你自己上传的文件重复的新课程资料。
